articles.summary: Healthpeak Properties, Inc. (NYSE: DOC) ("Healthpeak"), a leading owner, operator, and developer of real estate for healthcare discovery and delivery, today announced results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. THIRD QUARTER 2026 FINANCIAL PERFORMANCE AND RECENT HIGHLIGHTS Net income of $0.02 per share and FFO as Adjusted of $0.44 per share Outpatient Medical new and renewal lease executions totaled 846,000 square feet, bringing year-to-date Outpatient Medical lease executions to 3.2 million square feet Subsequent to the third quarter, 1.3 million square feet of Outpatient Medical leases have been executed or are under letter of intent ("LOI") Lab new and renewal lease executions totaled 480,000 square feet, bringing year-to-date Lab lease executions to 1 million square feet Subsequent to the third quarter, 643,000 square feet of Lab leases have been executed or are under LOI Lab total occupancy increased sequentially by +130 basis points ("bps") and is up +270 bps since
articles.title: Healthpeak Properties Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results and Increases Full Year 2026 Earnings Guidance
